Decode payload first. Gather numeric fields left-to-right: digits are nonnegative coefficients, ~N is negative N; optional ~[w] prefix records original zero-padding width. Invert 1 Haar lifting levels: take at most 1 active lengths starting at field count and repeatedly ceil-halving while above 1; undo in reverse. For active length n, first ceil(n/2) fields are lows, rest details. Each low s and detail d restore a=s-floor(d/2), b=a+d; interleave pairs, carrying last low if odd. Put nonnegative results back at field positions, padding recorded widths with zeros. Preserve all other text; print only.
